author: @tech_rant_daily
raw_statement: Can we talk about how Google Photos search has actually gotten WORSE? I used to be able to type 'receipts from Home Depot' and it would find them instantly using OCR. Now I get a grid of random home photos. @googlephotos what happened??

author: @PhotoNerd99
raw_statement: Day 400 of asking @googlephotos to add a simple 'Sort by Size' or 'Find Duplicates' feature on the web app so I don't have to pay for Google One storage when half my cloud is just burst shots of my cat. 😭

author: @UX_designer_Sarah
raw_statement: The lack of nested folders in Google Photos is a UI nightmare. If I have a '2023 Vacation' album, I should be able to put 'Paris', 'Rome', and 'London' inside it. Having 500 flat albums makes organizing completely pointless.

author: @DevopsDan
raw_statement: I love when Google Photos face recognition decides that my brother with a beard is an entirely different human being than my brother without a beard, and there's no fast way to merge their 400 photos together. So smart.

author: @MomLife101
raw_statement: Why does searching for multiple people simultaneously literally never work? If I search for 'Lily and Jack', it just says no results. I KNOW I have a thousand pictures of my kids together. Make it make sense! 🤦‍♀️ #GooglePhotos
